s01_01.text: Hello, friends! Today we talk about feelings!

s01_02.text: Beep beep! Let's find out how we feel!

s02_01.text: I am smiling. I feel happy!

s02_02.text: I feel happy when we ride together!

s03_01.text: Can you make a happy face?

s05_01.text: When a friend is sad, we give a hug.

s06_01.text: Is Kitty happy or sad now?

s08_01.text: When we are angry, we take a big breath.

s09_01.text: Can you take a big breath?

s11_03.text: I am here, Froggy. Hold my hand.

s14_01.text: I have a surprise for you!

s15_01.text: Can you make a surprised face?

s17_02.text: When we are sleepy, we rest.

s17_03.text: Hop in. I will drive slowly.

s18_01.text: Hello, friends! How do you feel tonight?

s18_02.text: We feel happy to see you, Lumi!

s19_02.text: Yes! Kitty feels sad. A hug helps.

s22_01.text: Happy: we smile. Sad: we hug.

s22_02.text: Angry: we breathe. Scared: we hold hands.

s23_01.text: Thank you for sharing your feelings!

s23_02.text: Beep beep! Time to go home!
